title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten documented Ohio Northern environments for independent work, group projects, research, writing, tutoring, or focused reset time.

cards.title: Heterick Memorial Library
cards.subtitle: 525 South Main Street, Ada
cards.notes: Start here for library resources, then choose a floor or reservable room that fits the work you need to finish.
cards.short_summary: ONU’s undergraduate library, with research help and multiple study settings.
cards.evidence_claim: Heterick Memorial Library provides library resources and has rooms for individual study and small or large groups.
cards.access_notes: Check current library hours and room-reservation availability before going.

cards.entity_name: Oscar J. and Judith D. Mifsud Collaborative Learning Center
cards.title: Mifsud Collaborative Learning Center
cards.subtitle: First floor, Heterick Memorial Library
cards.notes: Bring a project partner and use the first-floor collaborative setting for shared screens, whiteboard work, or discussion.
cards.short_summary: A media-rich first-floor learning environment designed for collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU identifies the first floor of Heterick as the Mifsud Collaborative Learning Center, an open, media-rich collaborative-learning space.
cards.access_notes: Use during library access hours; check reservation information for enclosed rooms.

cards.title: Mifsud Center for Student Success
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Heterick Memorial Library
cards.notes: Set up with course materials in the renovated second-floor areas, then connect with academic support if you need it.
cards.short_summary: Renovated second-floor space with areas for individual and collaborative study.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU says the Mifsud Center’s renovated second floor includes expanded areas for students to study individually or collaborate on projects.
cards.source_title: ONU celebrates opening of Mifsud Center for Student Success
cards.access_notes: Located on Heterick’s second floor; support-service availability may vary.

cards.title: Sensory Room
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Heterick Memorial Library
cards.notes: Reserve a 30-minute session when adjustable lighting, cozy seating, and a calmer reset would help you refocus.
cards.short_summary: A reservable, private room for mindfulness and stress reduction.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sensory Room is open to the ONU community, accommodates up to three people for 30 minutes, and includes adjustable lighting and cozy seating.
cards.access_notes: Reserve for up to three people for 30 minutes; it is open to the ONU community.

cards.title: Writing Center
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Heterick Memorial Library
cards.notes: Bring a draft, outline, or research paper question and use a session to move the next revision forward.
cards.short_summary: Writing support space for ONU students at any stage of the process.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU’s Writing Center supports all ONU students at any stage of the writing process and is part of the Heterick-based Student Success Center.
cards.access_notes: Located in the second-floor Student Success area; confirm appointment or drop-in details with the center.

cards.title: Tutoring Center
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Heterick Memorial Library
cards.notes: Take a problem set or course question to a drop-in or scheduled tutoring session, then plan your next practice block.
cards.short_summary: Heterick-based tutoring for many undergraduate courses.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU offers free weekly drop-in and by-appointment tutoring for many undergraduate courses from its second-floor Heterick location.
cards.access_notes: Tutoring is on Heterick’s second floor; availability depends on course coverage and appointment schedules.

cards.title: Math and Statistics Resource Center
cards.subtitle: Tutoring services at Heterick Memorial Library
cards.notes: Use this tutoring setting for a 1000-level math or statistics question, then leave with a worked next step.
cards.short_summary: One-on-one tutoring support for introductory math and statistics courses.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU states that the Math and Statistics Resource Center provides one-on-one tutoring for all 1000-level mathematics and statistics courses.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current tutoring schedule and course coverage before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Ohio Northern University Archives Public Reading Room
cards.title: ONU Archives Public Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Third floor, Heterick Memorial Library
cards.notes: Schedule a visit before working with historical manuscripts, photographs, maps, or university publications in the reading room.
cards.short_summary: Appointment-based primary-source research space in Heterick Library.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU Archives materials are available for use in its public reading room on Heterick Memorial Library’s third floor.
cards.access_notes: Archives access is by appointment; contact archives@onu.edu to schedule a visit.

cards.title: Taggart Law Library
cards.subtitle: Pettit College of Law, Ohio Northern University
cards.notes: Use individual or group study areas with legal research tools when your work calls for cases, statutes, or study aids.
cards.short_summary: Law-library setting with technology-equipped individual and group study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Taggart Law Library provides multiple group and individual study spaces with embedded technology, alongside legal research resources.
cards.access_notes: Confirm visitor and access policies with the law library before relying on a study space.

cards.entity_name: David C. Crago Rare Book Room
cards.title: David C. Crago Rare Book Room
cards.subtitle: Taggart Law Library, Pettit College of Law
cards.notes: Ask library staff about access before planning research with the room’s rare legal materials and special collections.
cards.short_summary: Special-collections room for rare legal materials and faculty publications.
cards.evidence_claim: The David C. Crago Rare Book Room in Taggart Law Library houses rare legal materials and special collections.
cards.access_notes: Special-collections access rules are not stated on the page; contact Taggart Law Library before visiting.
